subhypotheses.statement: The completed xi function yields the precise RH statement through its nontrivial zero set and functional symmetry.
Li-type positivity provides an equivalent infinite criterion, not a finite certificate.
Certified finite-height verification supports bounded consequences without proving RH globally.
A claimed proof must establish every bridge map, theorem hypothesis, and tail implication without circularity.

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer RH from finitely many verified zeros or Li coefficients.
Do not infer that a zero-free region near Re(s)=1 proves the critical-line statement.
Do not call a repository claim a proof without independent mathematical verification.
Do not present proposed derivations as completed theorems or observed computational results.
